wikidot5e:spell:immovable-object.effectSummary: Touch an object weighing no more than 10 pounds to fix it magically in place for 1 hour. You and creatures chosen when casting can move it normally, and you may set a password that suppresses the spell for 1 minute when spoken within 5 feet. If fixed in midair it supports up to 4,000 pounds; excess weight makes it fall. Another creature can use an action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to move it up to 10 feet. A 4th- or 5th-level slot raises that DC by 5, capacity to 8,000 pounds, and duration to 24 hours; a 6th-level-or-higher slot raises the DC by 10, capacity to 20,000 pounds, and duration to permanent until dispelled.

wikidot5e:spell:imprisonment.effectSummary: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save; on success it is immune to your future castings of this spell, and on failure it is imprisoned until released. While imprisoned it does not age or need air, food, or water, and divination cannot locate or perceive it. You may define a reasonable observable release condition during casting. Only a 9th-level dispel magic targeting the prison or its special component can otherwise dispel it. Choose one prison form: Burial seals it in an impassable force sphere deep underground; Chaining restrains it with immovable chains; Hedged Prison places it in a warded demiplane; Minimus Containment shrinks it to 1 inch inside an unbreakable transparent gemstone; Slumber puts it into unwakeable sleep. Each form requires its own costly special component, and reusing the same component for another casting releases the prior prisoner.

wikidot5e:spell:incendiary-cloud.effectSummary: Create a heavily obscuring 20-foot-radius sphere of burning smoke within 150 feet for up to 1 minute; wind of at least 10 mph disperses it. When it appears, and whenever a creature first enters it on a turn or ends its turn there, that creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. At the start of each of your turns, the cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you in a direction you choose.

wikidot5e:spell:incite-greed.effectSummary: Present the spell's gem and choose any number of creatures within 30 feet that can see you. Each makes a Wisdom save or is charmed until the spell ends, you or your companions harm it, or it succeeds on a repeat save at the end of one of its turns. While charmed, it can do nothing except use movement to approach you safely; once within 5 feet, it stops moving and stares at the gem.

wikidot5e:spell:infallible-relay-ua.effectSummary: Choose a creature you have spoken with before on the same plane. The nearest functioning telephone or similar device within 100 feet of that creature rings; if none exists, the spell fails. The target makes a Charisma save or is compelled to answer. Once connected, the call remains perfectly clear and cannot drop until the conversation or spell ends. You may end it freely; the target must succeed on a Charisma save to end it.

wikidot5e:spell:infernal-calling.effectSummary: Summon a CR 6-or-lower devil of a chosen type into a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour. It is unfriendly, has its own initiative, and is DM-controlled. Each turn you may issue a verbal command without an action; it obeys if the result suits its desires, otherwise make Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) contested by its Wisdom (Insight), with advantage if you use its true name. On a failed contest it becomes immune to your commands for the rest of the spell. If concentration ends early after it became immune, it remains for 3d6 minutes acting as it wishes before disappearing. Possessing that individual devil's talisman lets you summon it at up to the normal CR limit plus 1 and makes it obey without contests. Each slot level above 5th raises the maximum CR by 1.

wikidot5e:spell:infestation.effectSummary: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 1d6 poison damage and, if able to move at least 5 feet, moves 5 feet in a random cardinal direction determined by 1d4; this movement does not provoke opportunity attacks, and it does not move if that direction is blocked. Damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.

wikidot5e:spell:inflict-wounds.effectSummary: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit it takes 3d10 necrotic damage. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d10 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:insect-plague.effectSummary: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of biting insects within 300 feet for up to 10 minutes. It spreads around corners, lightly obscures its area, and makes it difficult terrain. When it appears, and whenever a creature first enters on a turn or ends its turn there, that creature makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d10 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:intellect-fortress.effectSummary: For up to 1 hour, you or one willing visible creature within 30 feet has resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. Each slot level above 3rd adds one target, with all targets within 30 feet of one another when chosen.
